product_analysis.product_type: Privacy-focused offshore infrastructure reseller platform (Domains, Offshore cPanel Hosting, VPS, Windows RDP, Private Email, Developer API, Crypto Wallet)
product_analysis.benchmark: Dynopay.com (editorial clarity, high-contrast light-first canvas, indigo accents, monospace metadata tags, generous whitespace, sandbox/test badges, multi-step card checkout)
product_analysis.target_audience: Developers, offshore entrepreneurs, privacy enthusiasts, system admins, crypto-native founders

user_journey_flows.domain_purchase_flow: 1. Search query on hero -> 2. Instant inline domain search table with TLD pills & price -> 3. Add to Cart / Configure WHOIS Privacy & Nameservers -> 4. Enter Multi-Step Checkout inside App Shell (Configure -> Review -> Wallet Pay -> Instant Activation Receipt)
user_journey_flows.vps_rdp_provision_flow: 1. Select Region (EU / Singapore) -> 2. Select Spec Tier (vCPU, RAM, SSD) & OS -> 3. Choose Billing Cycle (7-day test / Monthly / Annual) -> 4. Multi-Step Checkout Stepper -> 5. Instant credentials reveal modal + active server management card
user_journey_flows.wallet_topup_flow: 1. Check wallet balance chip in TopBar -> 2. Open Wallet modal or page -> 3. Select Preset Amount ($20, $50, $100, $250) -> 4. Choose Crypto (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL) -> 5. Generate DynoPay payment link/QR -> 6. Real-time balance refresh on confirmation

option_1.name: Option 1: Editorial Indigo & Obsidian (Dynopay Benchmark Default)
option_1.concept: Clean, light-first public canvas with deep obsidian dark mode. Features editorial serif/display headlines, high contrast Indigo accents, crisp 1px borders, monospace technical metadata tags, and elevated single-card focus areas.

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
hierarchy.section_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink
hierarchy.mono_eyebrow: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-brand

geometry_and_styling.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for inputs/buttons, rounded-full for pills
geometry_and_styling.shadows: shadow-sm for flat cards, shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/5 for interactive elements

option_2.name: Option 2: Swiss Technical & Emerald Tactical
option_2.concept: A high-density, engineer-grade tactical interface. Deep slate dark base with vivid Emerald green telemetry indicators, high-contrast monospace data grids, cardless container lines, and military-precision status chips.

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.section_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink uppercase
hierarchy.mono_eyebrow: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-success font-semibold

geometry_and_styling.border_radius: rounded-md for all containers (sharp technical aesthetic)

public_navigation.style: Sticky Crystal Glassmorphism header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80 border-b border-line z-50
public_navigation.elements: Logo with brand icon + Brand Name, Navigation Links (Domains, Hosting, VPS & RDP, Private Email, Pricing, API), Language Selector (EN/ES/FR), Theme Toggle (Light/Dark), Sign In Link, Create Account CTA

hero_section.composition: Two-column grid or high-impact editorial split. Left: Large editorial title with 1 highlighted gradient text span, monospace metadata badge ('OFFSHORE INFRASTRUCTURE v2.4'), value props with checkmarks. Right: Live interactive Product Search Card or Sandbox Preview Card with 'SANDBOX ACTIVE' status pill.
hero_section.search_bar: Massive rounded-2xl or rounded-xl input with embedded TLD dropdown, live availability status trigger, and high-visibility Search CTA button.

app_shell.sidebar: Collapsible left navigation with clean icons (Lucide React), categorized into Overview, Infrastructure (Domains, Hosting, VPS/RDP), Billing (Orders, Wallet, Invoices), Developer (API Keys), Settings.
app_shell.topbar: Global Command Palette / Search input, Wallet Balance Chip with quick +Add Funds modal trigger, Test Mode Indicator Badge (when dry-run active), Language Switcher, User Dropdown Menu with avatar.

unified_checkout_stepper.location: Inside the app shell context (maintaining sidebar + topbar context)

steps.name: Configure
steps.details: Choose domain WHOIS privacy, server location (EU/SG), OS image, SSH keys, billing cycle (7-day / 30-day / 1-year)

steps.name: Review & Promo
steps.details: Itemized cost breakdown, TLD ICANN fees, promo code input, instant subtotal recalculation

steps.name: Pay with Wallet
steps.details: Shows current wallet balance vs order total. Inline 'Top up $' button if balance is insufficient

steps.name: Confirmation
steps.details: Instant activation status, root credentials / cPanel login reveal, WHOIS privacy confirmation

tables_and_cards.data_table: Clean, dense row lines with monospace IPs/IDs, status pills (Active: green, Pending: amber, Suspended: red), quick action buttons (DNS Manager, Console, Reboot, Renew).
tables_and_cards.product_card: Minimalist card with top pill ('Popular', 'Privacy Tier'), prominent price/month in large mono font, feature checklist, and primary action button.

forbidden_ai_slop_patterns: NEVER use generic centered layouts with no visual contrast or asymmetry.
NEVER use Inter font for headlines or large text (use display font like Outfit or Space Grotesk).
NEVER use plain full-screen dark gradients with 100% opacity dark backgrounds without subtle borders.
NEVER use emojis as UI icons (e.g. 🤖, 💻, 🔒). Always use Lucide icons.
NEVER use default browser select inputs or native date pickers.
NEVER use pure black #000000 or pure white background without subtle 1px border separation for cards.
NEVER leave interactive elements without hover/focus states or data-testid attributes.

testing_and_qa_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, dropdowns, table rows, cards) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='domain-search-input', data-testid='checkout-step-pay-button').
